newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Duma approves 1997 budget in principle.
newsitem.headline: Russian Duma approves 1997 budget in principle.

text.p: The opposition-dominated Russian State Duma lower house of parliament voted to pass the 1997 draft budget in principle on Sunday.
Deputies voted 268 to 57 for the draft and are expected to consider amendments before a final vote on the first reading later on Sunday.

The draft envisages a deficit of 3.5 percent of gross domestic product on revenues of 434.4 trillion roubles and expenditures of 529.8 trillion roubles, according to Finance Minister Alexander Livshits.
Deputies later approved the draft in the first reading by a vote of 263 to 111.
The Duma also decided to to consider the budget for second and third readings on December 25.
